missions.name: BREAK CONTACT
missions.objective: Have a friendly unit Fall Back from an enemy unit, then be alive and not ENGAGED at the end of that Battle Round.

discarded.name: PUSH FORWARD
discarded.objective: In a single Movement Phase, have at least 2 friendly units use the Advance action and end it in the enemy half of the battlefield.

primary.name: IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS
primary.objective: From the second Battle Round, at the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP for every 2 friendly units outside your deployment zone that are neither Below Half-Strength nor SUPPRESSED, up to 3 VP.

missions.name: INTO THE FRAY
missions.objective: Make a successful CHARGE against an enemy unit.

discarded.name: LAST STAND
discarded.objective: At the end of a Battle Round, control an objective that has a friendly unit Below Half-Strength in its Objective Area.

primary.name: STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION
primary.objective: From the second Battle Round, at the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP if an enemy unit in an Objective Area is SUPPRESSED or you destroyed an enemy unit in an Objective Area during that Battle Round, and 2 VP if your opponent's Primary Mission scored no VP during that Battle Round. If your opponent also holds STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION, their card counts as scoring only when its 1 VP condition is met.
